reviews.title: RGB with Noctua build quality!?
reviews.comment: My daughter came to me and asked if I would build her a all white and pink gaming PC. Never one to turn my kiddo away I agreed and went all in. One catch, I let her choose all the parts! My concerns gave way to bliss once she and I decided that we would do an all Thermaltake build. These fans are just what we were looking for. Super easy to install and the build quality is comparable to the Noctua ones that I have in my rig. The one cable for all is the icing on the cake for me. My only wish is that Best Buy would carry the reversible fan for this model. All in all, one of the most enjoyable builds that I have done and love the Thermaltake fans and the RGB.
reviews.author: RandyG
